entities.summary: Eleanna Christinaki is a Greek Cypriot professional basketball player. She was selected for the Greece women's national basketball team at the age of 17 and has since acquired 78 caps for her country. She is the second-youngest player in history to be selected for the team. Additionally, she has captained the U-20 national team.
